subject.title: Test methodology: enforce failing-first on fix-bearing PRs

question: Should fix-bearing PRs receive a non-blocking failing-first prompt in the PR template or review checklist, and should automated pre-patch CI enforcement be pursued at all?
rationale: The repository currently requires meaningful regression coverage but does not define a universal enforcement method; choosing a template prompt, review practice, or CI gate changes contributor workflow and ongoing maintenance burden.

options.title: Add a non-blocking checklist prompt
options.body: Add a concise failing-first question to the PR template or review checklist and require worked before/after examples only when maintainers request them.

options.title: Keep it as reviewer judgment
options.body: Retain the existing behavior-focused test-review guidance without creating a new standardized prompt or automation.

options.title: Sponsor a CI design
options.body: Open a bounded design effort for automated pre-patch validation only after defining eligible PRs, baseline checkout handling, and false-positive policy.

recommendation.title: Add a non-blocking checklist prompt
recommendation.body: Add a concise failing-first question to the PR template or review checklist and require worked before/after examples only when maintainers request them.
